How it works on the day

Good to know. Weddings, party buses and any booking of 20+ passengers or two or more vehicles carry the large-group cancellation window rather than the standard one.

  • Where we meet you: Write every address on the reservation as its own movement — getting-ready location, ceremony, reception, hotel — rather than describing the day as a round trip with implied stops. Name one point person we call on the day; it should not be the couple. Where a venue directs commercial vehicles to a particular entrance, put that instruction on the booking and the chauffeur will work from it.
  • Luggage: Dresses, suit bags, florals and gifts all need somewhere to sit. Tell us what is traveling with the party when you request the quote so the fit is confirmed in writing. The Executive White Sprinter is rated for up to 40 bags.
  • What we can and cannot do: Hourly charters start at four hours on every vehicle except the 56-passenger motorcoach, which starts at five. The motorcoach is the largest single vehicle we run; a full guest shuttle beyond that is a coordinated multi-vehicle fleet on one reservation. Anything the online quote cannot price — an unusual route, a multi-vehicle movement, a vehicle we hold for request only — goes to the reservations desk and comes back as a written quote before any card is charged.
  • What it costs: 12 hours in the Executive White Sprinter (seats 14): the hour ladder gives you 2 free hours, so you pay for 10: 10 × $145 = $1,450. Add 8% Arizona tax; there is no booking fee and no fuel fee. How the rest settles depends on how you pay: a 50% deposit holds the date and the balance is charged to the card on file 48 hours before pickup; paying in full at checkout leaves nothing else due before your ride; a payment link from the reservations desk is due before the ride.

Frequently asked questions

How much does wedding transportation cost in Scottsdale?

Wedding pricing depends on the vehicle count, schedule, wait time, and routes between the hotel, ceremony, photo locations, reception, and final return.

Can you coordinate with our wedding planner?

Add the planner or day-of contact to the request. Pickup points, ceremony timing, photo stops, and reception arrival are reviewed, and accepted details are confirmed in writing.

Do you provide airport shuttle for wedding guests?

Airport and hotel movements can be requested. Submit the flights, luggage counts, passenger groups, and schedule so vehicle fit and pickup procedures can be reviewed and confirmed in writing.

What does the interior look like for weddings?

Cabin layout, lighting, and chauffeur presentation vary by the selected vehicle and written service terms. Choose the exact vehicle first, then confirm any wedding-specific presentation request before the date.

How far in advance should we book wedding transportation?

Earlier requests usually provide more vehicle and schedule options, especially on high-demand dates. Availability is not guaranteed until the vehicle, timing, route, and written terms are confirmed.

What details should be in a wedding transportation schedule?

List each passenger group, hotel or address, ceremony and reception location, hard arrival target, property-supplied loading instructions, final return, and planner or day-of contact. Rehearsal dinners, photo stops, and after-party movements should be listed separately when they affect the route. The accepted schedule and vehicles are confirmed in writing.
